[[Blind Faith]] |sandbox = No |rewards_increase = None }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Debuffs applied to towers last 50% longer, debuffs applied from towers have a 10% longer duration.|In-Game Description}} }} ==Description== '''The Tower''' is one of the curses that appears in the [[Null & Void Event]]. It can be voted for by the players every few waves. If voted for, it will boost debuff durations for towers and enemies. ==Effects== When applied, all debuffs applied by enemies, like the ones from the [[Null Pyromancer]], will get increased by 50%. To compensate, debuffs applied by towers, like the [[Jester]]'s confusion, will be increased by 10%. While not mentioned by the curse, it also boosts the duration of some other effects which are not debuffs, like the [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability duration, though others like the [[Firework Technician]] detection buff are not affected. ==Trivia== *'''The Tower''' is based on the [[wp:The Tower (tarot card)|The Tower]] tarot card. ==Update History== *'''18 October 2025''' - [[v1.77.0]] **'''The Tower''' added. *'''31 October 2025''' - [[v1.79.0]] **Tower debuff duration buff decreased from 25% to 10%. * '''26 November 2025''' - [[V1.80.0|v1.80.1d]] ** '''The Tower''' removed. {{ModifierNavBox}}
